description: Full-text search across every note with optional filters. Returns ranked hits with snippets and note ids for brain_read. Keywords or a short question both work (hybrid keyword + semantic search with spelling correction); the reply states its coverage.

project.description: Restrict to one project, e.g. 'Website Redesign'

since.description: Only notes modified on/after this date

topic.description: Restrict to notes tagged with a concept, e.g. 'OAuth'
